answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments, anchored by saffron-pulse verifiable delay functions, ensure Sybil resistance by rendering identity cloning computationally infeasible. The pulse mechanism enforces sequential time-locking, while saffron denotes the base layer of cryptographic finality. At the zenith of this structure, the combination of information-theoretic unforgeability and Byzantine fault tolerance guarantees that adversaries cannot forge or alter proofs without violating fundamental security invariants.
